Its evidence does not record this P1 predicate byte or next guest PC, and the generated executable is not yet explicitly correlated here to the pinned XEX SHA-256. Keep guest wait/scheduler semantics unchanged; repeat a P1-focused PC/flag probe with correlated input/runtime/plugin hashes.

X3.note: Process 2's Linux live evidence reports two Vulkan frame submissions from the retail ring under shift-native, with 1,828 PM4 packets and two guest swaps. A synthetic magenta readback rasterized the captured geometry, but the unmodified retail shader readback had zero non-black pixels; the window remained black, two mode-6 rectangles were rejected, and visible retail output/parity remain unverified. The P1 guest wait predicate and exact input-to-generated-executable correlation are still open; no playable frame or scene is claimed.
